effect_resolution_gate.reason: exclude algebraic/floating residuals and unresolved relative effects before shape classification

factor_pass_aggregation: at least one required-torque response AND at least one factor-specific mechanistic component must each pass nonproportionality and configuration-dependence for the same sign
factor_sign_pass_rule: effect resolution AND proportional_NRMSE>1e-4 AND affine_R2<0.9999 on the same predeclared response

fits.r2: 1-SSE/sum((y_perturbed-mean(y_perturbed))^2); undefined denominator -> null and no support

nonproportionality_thresholds.provenance: retains the prior outcome-independent mechanistic thresholds and adds an explicit effect-resolution floor
